By signing this Financial Bid, Bidders accept that any Purchase Order pursuant to this Bid will be subject to the OSCE General Conditions of Contract: https://procurement.osce.org/key-procurement-documents.

Currency of the Bid:	EUR or USD. All prices shall be quoted excl. VAT. Applicable taxes are to be shown separately. In case where the ITB documents permit Bids to be priced in several currencies, the OSCE shall convert all such prices into EUR using the list of OSCE currency exchange rates for the date on which the deadline for the receipt of Bids was set.

Delivery time: 	The goods shall be delivered within a maximum of 180 calendar days from the receipt of the OSCE Purchase Order, including the time required for obtaining export permit/license, if necessary.
Supply and delivery of goods and provision of all associated services shall be performed in accordance with Annex D – Terms of Reference and Technical Compliance Form.

*The OSCE will have a registered project registration card in Ukraine, accredited by the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine. Therefore, the goods can be imported to Ukraine as International Technical Assistance with exemption from taxation and customs duties. However, the required customs clearance must still be passed by the Contractor (i.e., hiring a customs broker, arriving at the Ukrainian customs terminal, coordination, obtaining a tax declaration of imported goods, etc.). The supporting documents from the OSCE and recipients in Ukraine will be provided as required.
Delivery of goods to Kyiv, Ukraine. The exact addresses will be clarified and provided to the Contractor at a later stage.
End users:		The goods are for donation to the following Beneficiaries:
State Border Guard Service of Ukraine
The distribution of the vehicles between the Beneficiaries is as follows:
State Customs Service of Ukraine – 5 vehicles
State Border Guard Service of Ukraine – 8 vehicles
State Customs Service of Ukraine – 5 vehicles
LOT 4 – OPTIONAL VEHICLES FROM LOTS 1-3 FOR POSSIBLE FUTURE NEEDS
